hero.badge: First LASIK Pioneer in the Pacific Region
hero.title: Vision, perfected
hero.subtitle: Bespoke refractive surgery by Dr. Charles Flowers, MD — the first LASIK pioneer in the Pacific region.

lasik.title: LASIK
lasik.description: Bladeless femtosecond flap creation with excimer reshaping. 15-minute procedure, next-day vision.

prk.title: PRK
prk.description: Surface ablation without a corneal flap. Ideal for thin corneas or active lifestyles.

icl.title: ICL
icl.description: Implantable Collamer Lens for extreme prescriptions. Reversible, UV-protective, permanent.

pioneer.title: Dr. Charles Flowers, MD
pioneer.paragraph1: Dr. Flowers performed the first LASIK procedures across Guam, Saipan, Palau, and the Marshall Islands — bringing sight-restoring surgery to remote Pacific communities that had never had access to refractive care.
pioneer.paragraph2: Today, that same pioneering spirit drives every procedure at Atelier. Over 30,000 successful surgeries. A 99.2% patient satisfaction rate. The precision of a craftsman applied to the gift of vision.

wavefront.title: Custom wavefront mapping
wavefront.description: Every eye is unique. We create a topographic map of your cornea to guide laser treatment with sub-micron accuracy.

expertise.title: Pacific-tested expertise
expertise.description: Dr. Flowers honed his craft in challenging conditions across remote islands. Los Angeles patients benefit from that depth of experience.

consultations.title: Same-week consultations
consultations.description: No waitlists. Comprehensive evaluation, honest candidacy assessment, and a clear path forward within days.

testimonial.quote: I woke up the next morning and could read the clock across the room. After twenty years of glasses, it felt like a miracle.
testimonial.author: Sarah M., LASIK patient, 2024

cta.title: Your consultation awaits
cta.subtitle: A 90-minute evaluation to determine your candidacy, map your cornea, and design a treatment plan tailored to your eyes.
